The Linters job in the Unit Tests workflow failed during the Pre-Commit step. Pre-commit hooks (end-of-file-fixer, trailing-whitespace, ruff, and ruff-format) detected formatting issues in 4 files and automatically fixed them, which caused the hooks to report failure (exit code 1). This is a configuration issue where the pre-commit hooks are set to fail when they modify files, rather than just reporting issues or being run in check-only mode. The affected files are lm_eval/models/huggingface.py, lm_eval/tasks/sparc/sparc.yaml, lm_eval/tasks/sparc/utils.py, and lm_eval/tasks/sparc/README.md. The root cause is that code changes introduced formatting inconsistencies that the pre-commit hooks auto-fixed, triggering the CI failure. To resolve, either run 'git add -A && git commit' to commit the formatting changes, or configure pre-commit to run in check-only mode for CI.
